rockArt.reason: The Lavaridge tileset's pink volcanic rock with its dark stones (Jagged Pass, Mt. Chimney's summit) - every one of these metatiles a blocked cell drew flat in the sweep of 2026-10-30; not its lava, its trees or its town. Blocked, it stands as a rock band; walked, it stays ground. Local metatile ids.

solidTrees.reason: The Lavaridge tileset's trees - the General tileset's large tree on Jagged Pass's rock, its lower row also under the next crown, and its small tree's trunk on Route 112's terraces, on the forest floor and inside a wood - which the 3D renderer stands as solids (src/diorama/scene/tree_sprites.c, DioramaTreeSprites_LavaridgePart: this list). Their cells joined the rock bands round them; each tree stands on the walkable ground it grows from instead. Local metatile ids: large, the quarters' (upper left, upper right, lower left, lower right); small, the trunks'.
